steps.note: Open the Single Stage create screen.
Set the event type to Auction so the auction pricing sheet is available.
Provide the required event title for a create flow.
Apply the first available auction template so the pricing sheet can be rendered.
Add the specified product as the first line item.
Render and populate the auction pricing sheet before editing the quantity cell.
Type the invalid letters into the first row's quantity cell and press Tab to trigger validation.
Verify that the quantity cell does not retain the non-numeric value.
